# Program reference

Every entry of the `programs:` list of a run configuration names one of these programs in its `program` key; the other keys of the entry are the fields listed below. Paths are resolved against the working directory. `python -m lunarops describe-program <Name>` prints the same contract.

| Program | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`NormalPointsConvert`](#normalpointsconvert) | Import CRD, MINI, or native normal points into one canonical file. |
| [`StationCatalogCreate`](#stationcatalogcreate) | Create a native ITRF station catalog from XYZ or WGS84 geodetic coordinates. |
| [`ReflectorCatalogCreate`](#reflectorcatalogcreate) | Create a native Moon-PA reflector catalog from a source file or inline XYZ. |
| [`MassCatalogCreate`](#masscatalogcreate) | Normalize configured body GMs and create a native dynamics mass catalog. |
| [`IersC04EarthOrientationParameter`](#iersc04earthorientationparameter) | Convert an IERS 20 C04 daily file to the native Earth-orientation format. |
| [`IersRapidEarthOrientationParameter`](#iersrapidearthorientationparameter) | Convert IERS finals2000A Bulletin-A rapid and prediction values to native EOP. |
| [`EarthOrientationParameterMerge`](#earthorientationparametermerge) | Merge C04 and Bulletin-A EOP, preferring C04 on overlapping days. |
| [`LlrResiduals`](#llrresiduals) | Evaluate LLR O-C residuals and diagnostics. |
| [`LlrProcessing`](#llrprocessing) | Run nonlinear LLR estimation and explicit processing output steps. |
| [`LlrObservationPrediction`](#llrobservationprediction) | Predict LLR uplink pointing, Sun elevation, mean elongation, and visibility windows. |
| [`LlrObservationPredictionMerge`](#llrobservationpredictionmerge) | Merge disjoint native LLR prediction grids and rebuild visibility windows. |
| [`LunarOrbitPropagation`](#lunarorbitpropagation) | Propagate the Earth/Moon hybrid subsystem and compare with the input ephemeris. |

## Data preparation

### NormalPointsConvert

Import CRD, MINI, or native normal points into one canonical file.

**Files**

| Field | Direction | Artifact type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inputFilesNormalPoints` | input | list of external file | yes | CRD v2, MINI or native normal-point files, or directories searched recursively for them. |
| `outputFileNormalPoints` | output | `normalPoint` | yes | Output canonical normal-point file. |
| `outputFileImportReport` | output | `normalPointImportReport` | yes | Output report with source checksums, record counts and rejected lines. |

**Options**

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `datasetName` | string | `normal-points` |  | Name stored in the header of the output file. |
| `crdUncertaintyPolicy` | string |  | one of `binRmsAsSigma`, `fixed` | Source of the two-way uncertainty of CRD normal points: `binRmsAsSigma` uses the bin RMS of record 11, `fixed` uses `crdUncertaintyTwoWayS`. Required for CRD input. |
| `crdUncertaintyTwoWayS` | number |  | > 0 | Two-way uncertainty assigned to every CRD normal point under the `fixed` policy, in seconds. |
| `crdMeteorologyMaxAgeSeconds` | number | `1800.0` | ≥ 0 | Largest allowed time between a CRD normal point and the nearest meteorological record, in seconds. |
| `miniTemperatureUnit` | string | `deciCelsius` | one of `deciCelsius`, `deciKelvin` | Unit of the MINI temperature field: `deciCelsius` (0.1 °C) or `deciKelvin` (0.1 K). |

### StationCatalogCreate

Create a native ITRF station catalog from XYZ or WGS84 geodetic coordinates.

**Files**

| Field | Direction | Artifact type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inputFileStationCoordinates` | input | external file | no | YAML coordinate source with a `stationCoordinates` list. Give either this or the inline `stationCoordinates`. |
| `outputFileStationCatalog` | output | `stationCatalog` | yes | Output native ITRF station catalog. |

**Options**

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stationCoordinates` | list of mapping |  | nullable; at least 1 items | Inline station coordinates. |
| `stationCoordinates[].key` | string |  | required | Station catalog key. |
| `stationCoordinates[].xyzM` | list of number |  | nullable; exactly 3 items | ITRF Cartesian position (X, Y, Z) at `positionEpochUtc`, in metres. Give either this or the three geodetic fields. |
| `stationCoordinates[].longitudeDeg` | number |  | nullable; ≥ -180; ≤ 180 | WGS84 geodetic longitude, east positive, in degrees. |
| `stationCoordinates[].latitudeDeg` | number |  | nullable; ≥ -90; ≤ 90 | WGS84 geodetic latitude, north positive, in degrees. |
| `stationCoordinates[].heightM` | number |  | nullable | WGS84 ellipsoidal height, in metres. |
| `stationCoordinates[].velocityMPerYear` | list of number | `[0.0, 0.0, 0.0]` | exactly 3 items | ITRF linear velocity (X, Y, Z), in metres per year. |
| `stationCoordinates[].positionEpochUtc` | string | `'2010-01-01T00:00:00'` |  | UTC reference epoch of the position, as an ISO timestamp. |

### ReflectorCatalogCreate

Create a native Moon-PA reflector catalog from a source file or inline XYZ.

**Files**

| Field | Direction | Artifact type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inputFileReflectorCoordinates` | input | external file | no | YAML coordinate source with a `reflectorCoordinates` list. Give either this or the inline `reflectorCoordinates`. |
| `outputFileReflectorCatalog` | output | `reflectorCatalog` | yes | Output native Moon-PA reflector catalog. |

**Options**

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reflectorCoordinates` | list of mapping |  | nullable | Inline reflector coordinates. |
| `reflectorCoordinates[].key` | string |  | required | Reflector catalog key. |
| `reflectorCoordinates[].xyzM` | list of number |  | required; exactly 3 items | Reflector position (X, Y, Z) in the lunar principal-axis (PA) frame of the selected ephemeris, in metres. |

### MassCatalogCreate

Normalize configured body GMs and create a native dynamics mass catalog.

**Files**

| Field | Direction | Artifact type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `outputFileMassCatalog` | output | `massCatalog` | yes | Output native mass catalog. |

**Options**

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `catalogName` | string |  | required | Name stored in the catalog header. |
| `source` | string | `''` |  | Provenance of the catalog as a whole. |
| `expectedBodyCount` | integer | `null` | nullable; ≥ 1 | If set, the run fails unless the catalog contains exactly this many bodies. |
| `expectedGroupCounts` | mapping |  |  | Expected number of bodies per group; the run fails on any mismatch. |
| `earthMoonCanonical` | mapping | `null` | nullable | Derive the Earth and Moon GM from the Earth-Moon system GM and the mass ratio, so all models share one consistent pair. |
| `earthMoonCanonical.gmbAu3Day2` | number |  | required; > 0 | GM of the Earth-Moon system, in au^3/day^2. |
| `earthMoonCanonical.emrat` | number |  | required; > 0 | Earth-to-Moon mass ratio. |
| `bodyMasses` | list of mapping |  | required; at least 1 items | Bodies of the catalog. |
| `bodyMasses[].bodyId` | string |  | required | Canonical body ID with NAIF semantics, such as `SUN`, `MARS BARYCENTER` or `NAIF:2000001`. |
| `bodyMasses[].name` | string | `''` |  | Human-readable body name. |
| `bodyMasses[].ephemerisTarget` | integer |  | required | NAIF integer ID used to query the body state from the ephemeris. |
| `bodyMasses[].gm` | number | `null` | nullable; > 0 | Gravitational parameter in `gmUnit`. Omitted for EARTH and MOON when `earthMoonCanonical` is given. |
| `bodyMasses[].gmUnit` | string | `m3/s2` | one of `au3/day2`, `m3/s2` | Unit of `gm`: `m3/s2` or `au3/day2`. |
| `bodyMasses[].groups` | list of string |  | required; at least 1 items | Group names used to select the body as a perturber, for example `de440_major` or `sb441_asteroid`. |
| `bodyMasses[].source` | string | `''` |  | Provenance of the value, stored in the catalog. |

**Files**

| Field | Direction | Artifact type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

### EarthOrientationParameterMerge

Merge C04 and Bulletin-A EOP, preferring C04 on overlapping days.

**Files**

| Field | Direction | Artifact type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inputFileC04EarthOrientationParameter` | input | `earthOrientationParameter` | yes | Native EOP file converted from C04. |
| `inputFileRapidEarthOrientationParameter` | input | `earthOrientationParameter` | yes | Native EOP file converted from finals2000A. |
| `outputFileEarthOrientationParameter` | output | `earthOrientationParameter` | yes | Output merged EOP file; C04 values take precedence on days present in both inputs. |

## Observation modelling and estimation

### LlrResiduals

Evaluate LLR O-C residuals and diagnostics.

**Files**

| Field | Direction | Artifact type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inputFilesNormalPoints` | input | list of `normalPoint` files | yes | Canonical normal-point files, or directories searched recursively for them. |
| `inputFileStationCatalog` | input | `stationCatalog` | yes | Native ITRF station catalog. |
| `inputFileReflectorCatalog` | input | `reflectorCatalog` | yes | Native Moon-PA reflector catalog. |
| `outputFileObservationResults` | output | `observationResult` | yes | Output observation-result table with one row per normal point. |

**Options**

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `startTime` | time |  | nullable | First transmit epoch to process (inclusive), as an ISO date or timestamp. A naive timestamp is read in the `utcOffsetHours` civil time; null means no lower bound. |
| `endTime` | time |  | nullable | Transmit epoch at which processing stops (exclusive), in the same form as `startTime`. Null means no upper bound. |
| `utcOffsetHours` | number | `0.0` | ≥ -24; ≤ 24 | Fixed civil-time offset from UTC in hours (whole minutes, -24 to 24). Applies to naive `startTime`/`endTime` values and to the local-time columns of the output; the model is always evaluated in UTC. |
| `overrideStation` | string |  | nullable | Station catalog key used for every normal point instead of the station identity recorded in the file. |
| `overrideReflector` | string |  | nullable | Reflector catalog key used for every normal point instead of the reflector identity recorded in the file. |
| `minElevationDeg` | number | `0.0` | ≥ 0 | Minimum vacuum elevation of the uplink and downlink at the station, in degrees. Normal points below it are excluded. |
| `lowElevationPolicy` | string | `rejectClamped` | one of `allowFlagged`, `rejectClamped` | Handling of normal points whose elevation lies below the validity floor of the troposphere model: `rejectClamped` excludes them, `allowFlagged` keeps them with the delay evaluated at the floor and flags them. |
| `showProgress` | boolean | `true` |  | Report progress while normal points are evaluated. |
| `mpi` | mapping |  |  | MPI scheduling options, used when the run is started with `--mpi`. |
| `mpi.chunksize` | integer | `8` | ≥ 1 | Number of tasks sent to an MPI worker per message. Larger values reduce messaging overhead; smaller values balance load. |
| `ephemerides` | [`ephemerides`](classes.md#ephemerides) class |  |  | Ephemeris model. Falls back to `models.ephemerides`. |
| `earthRotation` | [`earthRotation`](classes.md#earthrotation) class |  |  | Earth-orientation source. Falls back to `models.earthRotation`. |
| `troposphere` | [`troposphere`](classes.md#troposphere) class |  |  | Tropospheric delay model. Falls back to `models.troposphere`. |
| `relativity` | [`relativity`](classes.md#relativity) class |  |  | Relativistic (Shapiro) delay model. Falls back to `models.relativity`. |
| `stationDisplacement` | list of [`stationDisplacement`](classes.md#stationdisplacement) classes |  | at least 1 items | Station displacement models; their displacements are summed. Falls back to `models.stationDisplacement`. |
| `reflectorDisplacement` | [`reflectorDisplacement`](classes.md#reflectordisplacement) class |  |  | Reflector displacement model. Falls back to `models.reflectorDisplacement`. |
| `rangeBias` | [`rangeBias`](classes.md#rangebias) class |  |  | Deterministic range-bias correction applied to the computed observable. Falls back to `models.rangeBias`. |
| `outputLevel` | string | `standard` | one of `full`, `standard` | Column set of the observation-result table: `standard` (residuals and main diagnostics) or `full` (every model component). |
| `includeReflectorDesign` | boolean | `false` |  | Add the columns `design_reflector_pa_x/y/z`: partial derivatives of the one-way residual with respect to the reflector PA coordinates. |

### LlrProcessing

Run nonlinear LLR estimation and explicit processing output steps.

**Files**

| Field | Direction | Artifact type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inputFilesNormalPoints` | input | list of `normalPoint` files | yes | Canonical normal-point files, or directories searched recursively for them. |
| `inputFileProcessingState` | input | `processingState` | no | Processing state of an earlier run to continue from. Its scientific fingerprint must match the current inputs and models. |
| `inputFileStationCatalog` | input | `stationCatalog` | yes | Native ITRF station catalog (a-priori values). |
| `inputFileReflectorCatalog` | input | `reflectorCatalog` | yes | Native Moon-PA reflector catalog (a-priori values). |
| `inputFileEarthOrientationUncertainty` | input | external file | no | IERS 20 C04 daily EOP file whose UT1 and polar-motion uncertainties are the prior sigmas of the Earth-orientation corrections (`earthOrientationCorrection`). |

**Options**

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `startTime` | time |  | nullable | First transmit epoch to process (inclusive), as an ISO date or timestamp. A naive timestamp is read in the `utcOffsetHours` civil time; null means no lower bound. |
| `endTime` | time |  | nullable | Transmit epoch at which processing stops (exclusive), in the same form as `startTime`. Null means no upper bound. |
| `utcOffsetHours` | number | `0.0` | ≥ -24; ≤ 24 | Fixed civil-time offset from UTC in hours (whole minutes, -24 to 24). Applies to naive `startTime`/`endTime` values and to the local-time columns of the output; the model is always evaluated in UTC. |
| `overrideStation` | string |  | nullable | Station catalog key used for every normal point instead of the station identity recorded in the file. |
| `overrideReflector` | string |  | nullable | Reflector catalog key used for every normal point instead of the reflector identity recorded in the file. |
| `minElevationDeg` | number | `0.0` | ≥ 0 | Minimum vacuum elevation of the uplink and downlink at the station, in degrees. Normal points below it are excluded. |
| `lowElevationPolicy` | string | `rejectClamped` | one of `allowFlagged`, `rejectClamped` | Handling of normal points whose elevation lies below the validity floor of the troposphere model: `rejectClamped` excludes them, `allowFlagged` keeps them with the delay evaluated at the floor and flags them. |
| `showProgress` | boolean | `true` |  | Report progress while normal points are evaluated. |
| `mpi` | mapping |  |  | MPI scheduling options, used when the run is started with `--mpi`. |
| `mpi.chunksize` | integer | `8` | ≥ 1 | Number of tasks sent to an MPI worker per message. Larger values reduce messaging overhead; smaller values balance load. |
| `ephemerides` | [`ephemerides`](classes.md#ephemerides) class |  |  | Ephemeris model. Falls back to `models.ephemerides`. |
| `earthRotation` | [`earthRotation`](classes.md#earthrotation) class |  |  | Earth-orientation source. Falls back to `models.earthRotation`. |
| `troposphere` | [`troposphere`](classes.md#troposphere) class |  |  | Tropospheric delay model. Falls back to `models.troposphere`. |
| `relativity` | [`relativity`](classes.md#relativity) class |  |  | Relativistic (Shapiro) delay model. Falls back to `models.relativity`. |
| `stationDisplacement` | list of [`stationDisplacement`](classes.md#stationdisplacement) classes |  | at least 1 items | Station displacement models; their displacements are summed. Falls back to `models.stationDisplacement`. |
| `reflectorDisplacement` | [`reflectorDisplacement`](classes.md#reflectordisplacement) class |  |  | Reflector displacement model. Falls back to `models.reflectorDisplacement`. |
| `rangeBias` | [`rangeBias`](classes.md#rangebias) class |  |  | Deterministic range-bias correction applied to the computed observable. Falls back to `models.rangeBias`. |
| `parametrization` | list of [`parametrization`](classes.md#parametrization) classes |  | required; at least 1 items | Parameter blocks available to the estimation. Each entry is a class declaration such as `{type: reflectorPosition}`. |
| `varianceComponents` | list of mapping |  | required; at least 1 items | Observation groups that each receive their own sigma factor. Every retained normal point must match exactly one component. |
| `varianceComponents[].id` | string |  | required | Unique identifier of the variance component. |
| `varianceComponents[].station` | string |  | required | Station catalog key whose normal points belong to this component. |
| `varianceComponents[].start` | time |  | required | First UTC date of the component (inclusive). |
| `varianceComponents[].endExclusive` | time |  | nullable | UTC date at which the component ends (exclusive). Null means open-ended. |
| `varianceComponents[].wavelengthMinNm` | number |  | nullable; > 0 | Lower laser-wavelength bound of the component (inclusive), in nanometres. Null means no bound. |
| `varianceComponents[].wavelengthMaxExclusiveNm` | number |  | nullable; > 0 | Upper laser-wavelength bound of the component (exclusive), in nanometres. Null means no bound. |

#### `processingSteps` entries

Each entry of `processingSteps` is a mapping with a `type` key; the remaining keys depend on the type.

##### `screenObservations`

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `residual` | mapping |  |  | Prefit residual screening limits. |
| `residual.maximumAbsoluteM` | number | `20.0` | nullable; ≥ 0 | Rejection limit for the absolute prefit one-way residual, in metres. Null disables the test. |
| `residual.maximumAbsoluteByStationM` | mapping |  |  | Per-station replacement of `maximumAbsoluteM`, keyed by station catalog key, in metres. A null value disables the test for that station. |
| `reportedSigma` | mapping |  |  | Screening limits for the reported normal-point sigma. |
| `reportedSigma.minimumOneWayM` | number | `0.001` | ≥ 0 | Smallest plausible reported one-way sigma, in metres. Normal points reporting a smaller sigma are rejected; retained sigmas are not changed. |
| `reportedSigma.minimumFractionOfGroupMedian` | number | `0.1` | ≥ 0; ≤ 1 | Reported sigmas below this fraction of the median sigma of their variance component are rejected. The effective limit is the larger of this and `minimumOneWayM`. |

##### `selectParametrizations`

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `parametrizations` | list of string |  | required; at least 1 items; unique items | Parametrization types estimated by the following `estimate` steps, replacing the previous selection. |

##### `estimate`

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | required | Unique name of the estimate step; it labels the step in reports. |
| `maxIterationCount` | integer | `3` | ≥ 1 | Maximum number of linearization iterations of the nonlinear adjustment. |
| `convergenceThreshold` | number | `0.01` | ≥ 0 | The step converges when the largest update of every parameter block is at most this value, in the block's unit (metres for positions and biases, using the 3-D norm per reflector or station). |
| `convergenceThresholdByParametrizations` | mapping |  |  | Per-block replacement of `convergenceThreshold`, keyed by parametrization type, in the block's unit. |
| `computeResiduals` | boolean | `true` |  | Evaluate postfit residuals after the step. Required by variance-factor and robust-weight estimation. |
| `estimateVarianceFactors` | boolean | `true` |  | Estimate the variance parameters of every variance component (see `varianceModel`). At every linearization the solution, the variance parameters (divided by the Gaussian consistency factor of the robust weight function) and the robust weights are iterated to their fixed point. |
| `estimateRobustWeights` | boolean | `true` |  | Estimate per-observation weight factors with the `robustWeighting` function, from residuals standardized by their variance under the current weights. |
| `robustWeighting` | mapping |  |  | Robust weighting function and thresholds. |
| `robustWeighting.model` | string | `igg3` | one of `directRejection`, `igg3` | Robust weighting function: `igg3` (full weight below `k0`, down-weighted between `k0` and `k1`, zero above `k1`) or `directRejection` (zero weight above `k0`). |
| `robustWeighting.k0` | number | `1.5` | > 0 | Lower threshold of the robust weighting function, in units of the standardized residual. |
| `robustWeighting.k1` | number |  | > 0 | Upper threshold of `igg3`, in units of the standardized residual; must exceed `k0` (6 if omitted). Not used by `directRejection`. |
| `sessionCorrelation` | boolean | `false` |  | Model one random offset per night session of each variance component (correlated normal points of one night) and estimate its sigma per component. |
| `sessionMaximumGapHours` | number | `4.0` | > 0 | Largest gap between consecutive normal points of one session, in hours. |
| `sessionInitialSigmaM` | number | `0.005` | > 0 | Starting sigma of the session offsets, in metres. |
| `varianceModel` | string | `scaled` | one of `floorAndScaled`, `scaled` | Variance function of each variance component. `scaled`: sigma = s * reported sigma. `floorAndScaled`: sigma^2 = a^2 + (s * reported sigma)^2, an error floor `a` added in quadrature, with `a` and `s` estimated by least-squares variance component estimation. A `scaled` estimate drops floors of earlier estimates. |
| `earthOrientationCorrection` | boolean | `false` |  | Estimate corrections of UT1 and the polar motion per station night (normal points of one station without a gap longer than `sessionMaximumGapHours`) as random effects, with the uncertainties of `inputFileEarthOrientationUncertainty` as prior sigmas. Requires the station position partials (a `stationPosition` parametrization). One station night determines only UT0 and the variation of latitude, so the corrections are reported as those two. |
| `earthOrientationSigmaScale` | number | `1.0` | > 0 | Factor applied to the tabulated Earth-orientation uncertainties. |

##### `writeResiduals`

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `outputFile` | path |  | required | Output observation-result file with the final postfit residuals. |
| `outputLevel` | string | `standard` | one of `full`, `standard` | Column set of the residual file: `standard` or `full`. |

##### `writeNormalEquations`

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `outputFile` | path |  | required | Output directory for the final normal equations. |

##### `writeResults`

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `outputFileReport` | path |  | nullable | Output processing report: convergence, statistics and publication quality. |
| `outputFileState` | path |  | nullable | Output processing state for continuing the run with inputFileProcessingState. |
| `outputFileSolution` | path |  | nullable | Output parameter vector with final values and formal uncertainties. |
| `outputFileCovariance` | path |  | nullable | Output directory with the parameter covariance matrix. |
| `outputFileReflectorCatalog` | path |  | nullable | Output reflector catalog updated with the estimated positions. |
| `outputFileStationCatalog` | path |  | nullable | Output station catalog updated with the estimated positions. |

#### `constraints` entries

Each entry of `constraints` is a mapping with a `type` key; the remaining keys depend on the type.

##### `aprioriSigma`

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `parameters` | list of string |  | required; at least 1 items | Patterns (`fnmatch`) of the constrained parameter names `object:type:temporal:interval`, e.g. `*:rangeBias*` or `APOLLO:position.*`. |
| `sigma` | number |  | required; > 0 | A-priori sigma, in the unit of the parameters. |

##### `minimalConstraints`

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stations` | list of string |  | at least 3 items; unique items | Datum stations (at least three). Defaults to every station whose position is estimated. |
| `conditions` | list of string | `[translation, rotation]` |  | Helmert parameters of the datum stations constrained to zero: `translation` (no-net-translation), `rotation` (no-net-rotation) and `scale`. |
| `sigmaM` | number | `0.0001` | > 0 | Sigma of each constrained Helmert parameter, in metres; rotations and scale are expressed as displacements at the Earth's equatorial radius. |

## Observation prediction

### LlrObservationPrediction

Predict LLR uplink pointing, Sun elevation, mean elongation, and visibility windows.

**Files**

| Field | Direction | Artifact type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inputFileStationCatalog` | input | `stationCatalog` | yes | Native station catalog that contains `stationName`. |
| `inputFileReflectorCatalog` | input | `reflectorCatalog` | yes | Native reflector catalog that contains `reflectorName`. |
| `outputFilePrediction` | output | `observationPrediction` | yes | Output table with one row per grid epoch. |
| `outputFileWindows` | output | `predictionWindow` | yes | Output table of visibility windows built from adjacent observable samples. |

**Options**

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `startTime` | time |  | required | First epoch of the prediction grid, as an ISO timestamp aligned to a whole millisecond. A naive timestamp is read in the `utcOffsetHours` civil time. |
| `endTime` | time |  | required | Last epoch of the prediction grid (inclusive when it falls on the grid), in the same form as `startTime`. |
| `utcOffsetHours` | number | `0.0` | ≥ -24; ≤ 24 | Fixed civil-time offset from UTC in hours (whole minutes). Applies to naive time inputs and to the local-time columns. |
| `stepSeconds` | number | `60.0` | > 0 | Spacing of the prediction grid, in seconds (a whole number of milliseconds). |
| `mpi` | mapping |  |  | MPI scheduling options, used when the run is started with `--mpi`. |
| `mpi.chunksize` | integer | `8` | ≥ 1 | Number of tasks sent to an MPI worker per message. Larger values reduce messaging overhead; smaller values balance load. |
| `stationName` | string |  | required | Station catalog key of the observing station. |
| `reflectorName` | string |  | required | Reflector catalog key of the target. |
| `minElevationDeg` | number | `20.0` | ≥ 0; ≤ 90 | Minimum topocentric elevation of the reflector at the station, in degrees. |
| `minReflectorElevationDeg` | number | `0.0` | ≥ -90; ≤ 90 | Minimum elevation of the incoming beam above the reflector's local lunar horizon, in degrees. |
| `maxSunElevationDeg` | number | `-6.0` | ≥ -90; ≤ 90 | Maximum Sun elevation at the station, in degrees (-6 is civil twilight). |
| `allowedElongationRangesDeg` | list of mapping | `[{startDeg: 0.0, endDeg: 360.0}]` | at least 1 items | Allowed intervals of the mean elongation D of the Moon from the Sun, in degrees. A sample is observable if D lies in any interval. |
| `allowedElongationRangesDeg[].startDeg` | number |  | required; ≥ 0; ≤ 360 | Start of the allowed mean-elongation interval, in degrees (inclusive). |
| `allowedElongationRangesDeg[].endDeg` | number |  | required; ≥ 0; ≤ 360 | End of the allowed mean-elongation interval, in degrees (inclusive). A value below `startDeg` wraps through 0. |
| `meteorologyPolicy` | string |  | required; one of `measured`, `nominal` | `nominal` uses representative weather (900 hPa, 285 K, 25 %, 532 nm) for any value not given; `measured` requires all four values. |
| `pressureHpa` | number |  | > 0 | Station surface pressure for the troposphere model, in hPa. |
| `temperatureK` | number |  | > 0 | Station surface temperature, in kelvin. |
| `relativeHumidityPercent` | number |  | ≥ 0; ≤ 100 | Station relative humidity, in percent. |
| `wavelengthNm` | number |  | > 0 | Laser wavelength, in nanometres. |
| `showProgress` | boolean | `true` |  | Report progress while the grid is evaluated. |
| `ephemerides` | [`ephemerides`](classes.md#ephemerides) class |  |  | Ephemeris model. Falls back to `models.ephemerides`. |
| `earthRotation` | [`earthRotation`](classes.md#earthrotation) class |  |  | Earth-orientation source. Falls back to `models.earthRotation`. |
| `troposphere` | [`troposphere`](classes.md#troposphere) class |  |  | Tropospheric delay model. Falls back to `models.troposphere`. |
| `relativity` | [`relativity`](classes.md#relativity) class |  |  | Relativistic (Shapiro) delay model. Falls back to `models.relativity`. |
| `stationDisplacement` | list of [`stationDisplacement`](classes.md#stationdisplacement) classes |  | at least 1 items | Station displacement models; their displacements are summed. Falls back to `models.stationDisplacement`. |
| `reflectorDisplacement` | [`reflectorDisplacement`](classes.md#reflectordisplacement) class |  |  | Reflector displacement model. Falls back to `models.reflectorDisplacement`. |

### LlrObservationPredictionMerge

Merge disjoint native LLR prediction grids and rebuild visibility windows.

**Files**

| Field | Direction | Artifact type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inputFilesPrediction` | input | list of `observationPrediction` files | yes | Prediction files of one station/reflector pair with disjoint epochs. |
| `outputFilePrediction` | output | `observationPrediction` | yes | Merged prediction table in chronological order. |
| `outputFileWindows` | output | `predictionWindow` | yes | Visibility windows rebuilt from the merged table. |

**Options**

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stepSeconds` | number |  | required; > 0 | Grid spacing of the inputs, in seconds; samples further apart start a new window. |

## Lunar dynamics

### LunarOrbitPropagation

Propagate the Earth/Moon hybrid subsystem and compare with the input ephemeris.

**Files**

| Field | Direction | Artifact type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inputFileMassCatalog` | input | `massCatalog` | yes | Native mass catalog with the GM of the Earth, the Moon and the perturbers. |
| `outputFileOrbit` | output | `lunarOrbit` | yes | Output binary table of the propagated Moon-relative state and its difference to the ephemeris. |
| `outputFileAccelerationDiagnostics` | output | `lunarAccelerationDiagnostics` | yes | Output binary table of the Moon acceleration split by force group. |
| `outputFileMetadata` | output | `lunarOrbitMetadata` | yes | Output metadata: resolved configuration, sources, checksums and statistics. |
| `outputFileRotation` | output | `lunarRotation` | no | Output binary table of the integrated rotation. Required with `lunarRotation`. |

**Options**

| Field | Type | Default | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ephemerides` | [`ephemerides`](classes.md#ephemerides) class |  | required | Ephemeris that supplies the prescribed Earth-Moon barycentre and external-body states, the initial Earth-Moon state and, for a rigid prescribed Moon, the lunar attitude. |
| `initialTdbJd1` | number |  | required | First part of the TDB Julian date of the initial epoch. |
| `initialTdbJd2` | number | `0.0` |  | Second part of the TDB Julian date of the initial epoch. |
| `durationSeconds` | number |  | required | Propagation span, in seconds; negative values propagate backwards. Must be a whole multiple of `stepSeconds`. |
| `backwardDurationSeconds` | number | `0.0` | ≥ 0 | Length, in seconds, of an additional arc propagated backward from the initial epoch, for a two-sided propagation with the forward arc of `durationSeconds`, which must then be positive and cover at least `integratorOrder` - 1 steps (more at small steps with the negative Earth-tide delays). A whole multiple of `stepSeconds`. |
| `outputStepSeconds` | number | `3600.0` | > 0 | Sampling interval of the orbit and rotation output tables, in seconds. |
| `accelerationDiagnosticsStepSeconds` | number | `null` | nullable; > 0 | Sampling interval of the acceleration diagnostics, in seconds; a whole multiple of `stepSeconds`. Null writes no diagnostic rows. |
| `includeEih` | boolean | `false` |  | Add the Einstein-Infeld-Hoffmann 1PN point-mass acceleration (`eih_1pn`). |
| `lunarDegree2Gravity` | mapping | `null` | nullable | Time-variable lunar degree-2 field under the ephemeris attitude. Requires a Moon gravity field; not combinable with `lunarRotation`. |
| `lunarDegree2Gravity.j2Undistorted` | number | `0.000203214360135` | > 0 | Undistorted lunar J2 (unnormalized), before tidal and rotational deformation. |
| `lunarDegree2Gravity.beta` | number | `0.0006312204073791423` | > 0; < 1 | Lunar moment-of-inertia ratio beta = (C - A) / B. |
| `lunarDegree2Gravity.gamma` | number | `0.00022778898477433167` | > 0; < 1 | Lunar moment-of-inertia ratio gamma = (B - A) / C; must be less than `beta`. |
| `lunarDegree2Gravity.loveK2` | number | `0.02419` | ≥ 0 | Lunar degree-2 potential Love number k2. |
| `lunarDegree2Gravity.tidalDelayDays` | number | `0.14519388258636395` | ≥ 0 | Time delay of the lunar tidal and rotational response, in days. |
| `lunarDegree2Gravity.radiusM` | number | `1738000.0` | > 0 | Reference radius of the lunar gravity field, in metres. |
| `lunarDegree2Gravity.meanMotionRadS` | number | `2.6616995e-06` | > 0 | Lunar orbital mean motion used in the rotational deformation, in rad/s. |
| `lunarDegree2Gravity.includeTidalDeformation` | boolean | `true` |  | Include the deformation raised by the Earth and Sun tides. |
| `lunarDegree2Gravity.includeRotationalDeformation` | boolean | `true` |  | Include the deformation caused by the lunar spin. |
| `lunarDegree2Gravity.c21Static` | number | `0.0` |  | Static unnormalized C21 added to the deformed degree-2 field. |
| `lunarDegree2Gravity.s21Static` | number | `0.0` |  | Static unnormalized S21 added to the deformed degree-2 field. |
| `lunarDegree2Gravity.s22Static` | number | `0.0` |  | Static unnormalized S22 added to the deformed degree-2 field. |
| `lunarRotation` | mapping | `null` | nullable | Integrate the mantle (and optional core) rotation together with the orbit. Requires `outputFileRotation`. |
| `lunarRotation.inertiaMoments` | list of number |  | required; exactly 3 items | Principal moments of inertia (A, B, C) of the undistorted Moon, normalized by M R^2 with R = `radiusM`. |
| `lunarRotation.radiusM` | number |  | required; > 0 | Reference radius used to normalize the moments of inertia, in metres. Must equal the Moon field radius. |
| `lunarRotation.initialEulerAnglesRad` | list of number |  | required; exactly 3 items | Initial mantle attitude as 3-1-3 Euler angles [phi, theta, psi] in radians, rotating PA axes to inertial axes as Rz(phi) Rx(theta) Rz(psi). sin(theta) must be nonzero. |
| `lunarRotation.initialAngularVelocityRadS` | list of number |  | required; exactly 3 items | Initial mantle angular velocity in PA-frame components, in rad/s. |
| `lunarRotation.initialCoreAngularVelocityRadS` | list of number | `null` | nullable; exactly 3 items | Initial fluid-core angular velocity in mantle PA-frame components, in rad/s. Required exactly when `core` is set. |
| `lunarRotation.sources` | list of string |  | required | Bodies whose gravity exerts a torque on the lunar figure, by mass-catalog body ID. Each must be in the selected bodies. |
| `lunarRotation.gravityTorque` | string |  | required; one of `figure`, `quadrupole` | Torque model for the `sources`: `quadrupole` uses the inertia tensor, `figure` the full Moon gravity field. |
| `lunarRotation.earthFigureTorque` | boolean | `false` |  | Add the torque from the Earth J2 acting on the lunar figure. Requires an Earth gravity field. |
| `lunarRotation.geodeticPrecession` | boolean | `false` |  | Include the relativistic geodetic precession in the transport of angular momentum. |
| `lunarRotation.core` | mapping | `null` | nullable | Fluid-core model. Null integrates a rigid mantle without a core. |
| `lunarRotation.core.polarMomentFraction` | number |  | required; > 0; < 1 | Polar moment of inertia of the fluid core as a fraction of the total polar moment C. |
| `lunarRotation.core.flattening` | number |  | required; ≥ 0; < 1 | Geometric flattening of the core-mantle boundary. |
| `lunarRotation.core.viscosityPerS` | number |  | required; ≥ 0 | Viscous core-mantle coupling coefficient k_v / C_c, in 1/s. Zero disables viscous coupling. |
| `lunarRotation.deformation` | mapping | `null` | nullable | Delayed tidal and rotational deformation of the integrated Moon. Null keeps the figure rigid. |
| `lunarRotation.deformation.loveK2` | number |  | required; ≥ 0 | Lunar degree-2 potential Love number k2. |
| `lunarRotation.deformation.delayDays` | number |  | required; > 0 | Time delay of the lunar deformation response, in days. Must not be shorter than `stepSeconds`. |
| `lunarRotation.deformation.meanMotionRadS` | number |  | required; > 0 | Lunar orbital mean motion used in the rotational deformation, in rad/s. |
| `lunarRotation.deformation.seedDurationSeconds` | number |  | required; > 0 | Length of the seed history integrated backwards before the start epoch to supply delayed states, in seconds. Must cover `delayDays`. |
| `lunarRotation.deformation.seedModel` | string |  | required; one of `rigidBackward` | How the seed history is produced: `rigidBackward` integrates the rigid Moon backwards from the initial state. |
| `lunarRotation.deformation.includeTidal` | boolean | `true` |  | Include the deformation raised by the external bodies' tides. |
| `lunarRotation.deformation.includeRotational` | boolean | `true` |  | Include the deformation caused by the lunar spin. |
| `lunarRotation.deformation.c21Static` | number | `0.0` |  | Static unnormalized C21 added to the deformed degree-2 field. |
| `lunarRotation.deformation.s21Static` | number | `0.0` |  | Static unnormalized S21 added to the deformed degree-2 field. |
| `lunarRotation.deformation.s22Static` | number | `0.0` |  | Static unnormalized S22 added to the deformed degree-2 field. |
| `gravityFields` | mapping | `null` | nullable | Static spherical-harmonic fields of the Earth and the Moon. At least one must be given. |
| `gravityFields.earth` | mapping |  |  | Static Earth gravity field, evaluated in the Earth-fixed axes selected by `earthPoleModel`. |
| `gravityFields.earth.path` | path |  | required | Spherical-harmonic gravity field file. |
| `gravityFields.earth.maxDegree` | integer |  | ≥ 0 | Highest degree loaded from the file. Defaults to the full field. |
| `gravityFields.earth.radiusM` | number |  | > 0 | Reference radius of the field, in metres. Defaults to the radius in the file header. |
| `gravityFields.earth.name` | string |  |  | Label of the field in metadata. Defaults to the body name. |
| `gravityFields.earth.allowMissingCoefficients` | boolean | `false` |  | Accept a file that omits some (degree, order) pairs up to `maxDegree`; the missing coefficients are zero and are listed in the metadata. |
| `gravityFields.moon` | mapping |  |  | Static Moon gravity field, evaluated in the lunar principal-axis frame. |
| `gravityFields.moon.path` | path |  | required | Spherical-harmonic gravity field file. |
| `gravityFields.moon.maxDegree` | integer |  | ≥ 0 | Highest degree loaded from the file. Defaults to the full field. |
| `gravityFields.moon.radiusM` | number |  | > 0 | Reference radius of the field, in metres. Defaults to the radius in the file header. |
| `gravityFields.moon.name` | string |  |  | Label of the field in metadata. Defaults to the body name. |
| `gravityFields.moon.allowMissingCoefficients` | boolean | `false` |  | Accept a file that omits some (degree, order) pairs up to `maxDegree`; the missing coefficients are zero and are listed in the metadata. |
| `moonFigurePartners` | list of string | `null` | nullable | Point-mass bodies that interact with the Moon gravity field, by mass-catalog body ID. Null uses EARTH and the default planets. |
| `earthFigurePartners` | list of string | `null` | nullable | Point-mass bodies that interact with the Earth gravity field, by mass-catalog body ID. The Moon takes the field acceleration directly and the Earth the reaction of every partner. Null mirrors `moonFigurePartners` with MOON in place of EARTH. |
| `earthDynamicsFrame` | string | `de440` | one of `de430`, `de440` | Earth-orientation model of the gravity axes when `earthPoleModel` is `ephemeris`: `de440` or `de430`. |
| `externalBodyGroups` | list of string | `[]` |  | Mass-catalog groups whose bodies act as prescribed perturbers. |
| `earthPoleModel` | string | `ephemeris` | one of `de430`, `de440`, `ephemeris`, `iau2006_2000a` | Earth-orientation model of the Earth gravity field axes: `ephemeris` (use `earthDynamicsFrame`), `de430`, `de440` or `iau2006_2000a`. |
| `externalBodyIds` | list of string | `[]` |  | Additional mass-catalog body IDs that act as prescribed perturbers. |
| `earthTide` | mapping | `null` | nullable | Delayed Earth tides raised by `tideRaisers`, acting on the Moon. Null disables the tide. |
| `earthTide.tideRaisers` | list of string | `[MOON, SUN]` |  | Bodies that raise tides on the Earth, by mass-catalog body ID. |
| `earthTide.k20` | number | `0.335` |  | Earth degree-2, order-0 potential Love number. |
| `earthTide.k21` | number | `0.277` |  | Earth degree-2, order-1 potential Love number. |
| `earthTide.k22` | number | `0.283` |  | Earth degree-2, order-2 potential Love number. |
| `earthTide.tauOrbDays` | list of number | `[0.077, -0.01, -0.20982243826832672]` | exactly 3 items | Orbital time delays of the order-0, order-1 and order-2 tides, in days. |
| `earthTide.tauRotDays` | list of number | `[0.0, 0.011929122823877609, -0.000742362752988307]` | exactly 3 items | Rotational time delays of the order-0, order-1 and order-2 tides, in days. |
| `earthTide.earthRotationRateRadS` | number | `7.29211514670698e-05` |  | Earth rotation rate used in the tidal delay, in rad/s. |
| `earthTide.earthRadiusM` | number | `6378136.6` | > 0 | Earth reference radius of the tidal potential, in metres. |
| `bodyForceTerms` | list of string |  | at least 1 items | Force terms applied to the Moon, from `point_mass`, `eih_1pn`, `solar_j2`, `figure_earth`, `figure_moon`, `tide`, `lense_thirring` and `solar_radiation_pressure`. Defaults to every configured term; `eih_1pn` requires `point_mass`. |
| `solarJ2` | number |  |  | Solar J2 (unnormalized), applied about the IAU solar pole. Omit to disable. |
| `solarGmVariation` | mapping | `null` | nullable | Linear drift of the solar GM. Null keeps it constant. |
| `solarGmVariation.fractionalRatePerYear` | number |  | required | Fractional rate of the solar GM, (dGM/dt)/GM, per Julian year. |
| `solarGmVariation.referenceJdTdb` | number |  | required | Epoch at which the solar GM equals its catalog value, as a TDB Julian date. |
| `kuiperBeltRing` | mapping | `null` | nullable | Ring of equal point masses in circular heliocentric orbits that represents the Kuiper belt. Null disables it. |
| `kuiperBeltRing.pointGmM3S2` | number |  | required; > 0 | GM of each ring point, in m^3/s^2. |
| `kuiperBeltRing.radiusAu` | number | `44.0` | > 0 | Ring radius, in astronomical units. |
| `kuiperBeltRing.pointCount` | integer | `36` | ≥ 3 | Number of ring points. |
| `kuiperBeltRing.obliquityArcsec` | number | `84381.448` |  | Inclination of the ring plane to the ICRF equator (the ecliptic obliquity), in arcseconds. |
| `kuiperBeltRing.referenceJdTdb` | number |  | required | Epoch at which the ring phase is `phaseDegrees`, as a TDB Julian date. |
| `kuiperBeltRing.phaseDegrees` | number | `0.0` |  | Longitude of the first ring point at `referenceJdTdb`, in degrees. |
| `earthJ2TimeVariation` | mapping |  |  | Polynomial time variation of the Earth J2: J2(t) = J2 + linearPerYear*T + quadraticPerYear2*T^2, with T in Julian years from `referenceJdTdb`. |
| `earthJ2TimeVariation.linearPerYear` | number | `0.0` |  | Linear rate of the Earth J2, per Julian year. |
| `earthJ2TimeVariation.quadraticPerYear2` | number | `0.0` |  | Quadratic coefficient of the Earth J2 polynomial, per Julian year squared (multiplies T^2 directly). |
| `earthJ2TimeVariation.referenceJdTdb` | number | `2451545.0` |  | Reference epoch of the Earth J2 polynomial, as a TDB Julian date. |
| `solarRelativistic` | mapping | `null` | nullable | Solar Lense-Thirring and radiation-pressure accelerations. Null disables both. |
| `solarRelativistic.includeLenseThirring` | boolean | `true` |  | Include the Lense-Thirring acceleration from the solar spin. |
| `solarRelativistic.includeRadiationPressure` | boolean | `false` |  | Include solar radiation pressure on the Moon and the Earth. |
| `solarRelativistic.moonEpsilon` | number | `0.0` |  | Radiation-pressure coefficient of the Moon (dimensionless). |
| `solarRelativistic.earthEpsilon` | number | `0.0` |  | Radiation-pressure coefficient of the Earth (dimensionless). |
| `solarRadiusM` | number | `696000000.0` | > 0 | Solar reference radius for the J2 field and the radiation model, in metres. |
| `stepSeconds` | number | `5400.0` | > 0 | Fixed step of the Adams-Bashforth-Moulton integrator, in seconds. |
| `integratorOrder` | integer | `13` | ≥ 2; ≤ 13 | Order of the Adams-Bashforth-Moulton integrator (2 to 13). |
| `correctorIterations` | integer | `2` | ≥ 1 | Number of corrector passes per step; 2 gives a PECEC scheme. |
| `historyInterpolationOrder` | integer | `13` | ≥ 1; ≤ 13 | Order of the local interpolation of the accepted history for delayed-state queries. |
| `trajectoryInterpolationOrder` | integer | `13` | ≥ 1; ≤ 13 | Order of the local interpolation between integration nodes for the output. |
| `startupStepSeconds` | number | `675.0` | > 0 | Step of the Dormand-Prince (DOP853) start-up integration that produces the first nodes, in seconds. |
